import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { noticedEvents } from "../../../backend/schema/noticed_events";

export const noticedEventsCms = customizeTable<typeof noticedEvents>("noticed_events", {
    icon: "Activity",
    listFields: ["id", "type", "recordType", "recordId", "notificationsCount", "params"],
    fields: {
        type: {
            multiline: true
        },
        recordType: {
            multiline: true
        }
    }
});
